name: Stefan Descheemaeker
current_role: Non-executive Director, Nomad Foods (CEO 2015-2025); Chairman, Verlinvest; Director, Oatly
profile: Belgian executive who ran Nomad Foods (Birds Eye, Iglo, Findus) as CEO from its 2015 acquisition of Iglo until retiring on 1 Jan 2026, staying on its board. Earlier he spent years at Interbrew/AB InBev (board member 2008-2019) and was Delhaize Group CFO then CEO Europe (2008-2013). He chairs Verlinvest, the Belgian investment firm and Oatly backer.
interesting_fact: At Interbrew he is credited with helping steer the 2004 Interbrew-AmBev merger that created InBev, the forerunner of AB InBev.
deep_cut_fact: Alongside his corporate career he has taught as a Professor of Business Strategy at the Universite Libre de Bruxelles (ULB).
notes: CEO handover to Dominic Brisby announced Oct 2025, effective 1 Jan 2026. Verlinvest (chairman) is a natural route for a food/consumer-investing angle; low public profile otherwise.

name: Sara Wechter
current_role: Chief Human Resources Officer, Citigroup (since July 2018)
profile: Career Citi executive who joined as an investment-banking analyst in 2004, moved to Corporate M&A and Strategy, then served as chief of staff to chairmen Richard Parsons and Michael O'Neill and CEO Mike Corbat. She has led Citi's global HR since 2018 and sits on the bank's management committee; her wealth reflects Citi equity awards.
interesting_fact: Named to Fortune's 40 Under 40 list in 2020; she drove high-profile Citi workforce policies such as hybrid work and expanded benefits and mental-health resources.
deep_cut_fact: An Emory alumna (class of 2003) who originally planned to focus on health care, until a first-year internship at a start-up pulled her toward business; at Citi she later worked on the Smith Barney sale during the financial crisis.
notes: Also on the boards of Onex Corp, Citi Foundation and NYU Langone overseers. Low public profile; HR executive rather than founder, so a weak fit for an energy/data-center podcast. Route via Citi corporate communications.
